ideas.pitch: A lightweight multilingual AI health companion providing preventive care and local outbreak alerts.
ideas.title: TinyHealth Rural Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages the winning pattern of solving real public health awareness challenges seen in SAGACITY.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition tracker that generates personalized regional meal plans for students.
ideas.title: SnackSmart AI Nutrition
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact formula of the E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant win by targeting everyday student wellness.

ideas.pitch: A quick-capture tool for student dev teams to log code context before hackathon submission deadlines.
ideas.title: DevKnowledge Capture
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a pain familiar to hackathon judges and organizers dealing with team knowledge handoffs.

ideas.pitch: A short narrative visual novel teaching water conservation strategies to children.
ideas.title: EcoSave Water Game
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses the engaging educational game approach proven by AquaQuest in the Smart India Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI platform that makes unstructured hackathon presentation videos fully searchable and indexable.
ideas.title: DocSearch AI Video Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the LibrAI winning architecture of turning unstructured data into searchable assets.
